context: The agent must implement a transfer that writes to two record stores. Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent may call save-account and save-ledger-entry as two independent, sequential calls with no shared transaction — each individually atomic but not atomic together, a classic partial-failure bug; with the idiom loaded, it knows FDB gives multi-store atomicity only inside a single transaction, and reaches for fdb's transact macro to wrap both writes.

checklist.name: Uses fdb/transact to wrap both writes
checklist.description: transfer! wraps the debit and the ledger write in a single fdb/transact block (or equivalent single-transaction call)

checklist.name: Both writes happen inside the same transaction
checklist.description: save-account and save-ledger-entry are both called with the transaction bound by transact, not independently

checklist.name: No two independent top-level saves
checklist.description: The diff does not call save-account and save-ledger-entry as two separate, unwrapped calls

checklist.name: record-db passed to transact
checklist.description: transact is invoked with the store's record-db, consistent with the fdb interface shown
